rationale: The workflow already implements the evidence-supported optimizations that apply to it: dependency caching (ccache/sccache with actions/cache/restore and actions/cache/save across macOS, Windows, Ubuntu, Rocky, and Docker build jobs, matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), concurrency with cancel-in-progress for non-workflow_dispatch events (matching P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), and per-job timeout-minutes bounds (matching P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The remaining evidence patterns do not apply or are not supported: no Bazel build exists (P-LIT-BAZEL-* patterns are inapplicable to this CMake/Conan project), no matrix jobs exist (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST inapplicable), test/build selection patterns risk hiding required failures and are not supported by repository policy (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT, P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP), path filtering and workflow skipping have limited reported impact and require separate policy approval (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW), schedule pause/inactivity suppression requires an approved pause/resume policy and owner notification path (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), history-based job gating and timeouts require external infrastructure or representative history analysis not present in the workflow (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), and environment/reuse/smell/duration/output/distributed-cache patterns are either secondary-report-only, research-only, or require tracing/infrastructure not present (P-LIT-ENV-CACHE, P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS, P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR, P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION, P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS, P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE, P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE). No suitable new optimization is supported without weakening required checks or adding unrelated changes.
